en: Mixing bleach and vinegar creates toxic chlorine gas, so you must never combine these two household cleaners.
Boiling drinking water for at least one minute kills harmful bacteria and makes it safe to consume.
Washing hands with soap destroys viruses because soap molecules break apart the protective fatty outer layer of the virus.
Electrical wires have a rubber coating because rubber is an insulator that prevents dangerous electric shocks.
Leaving a sealed plastic water bottle in a hot car increases the gas pressure inside until it bursts.
Shaking a bottle of liquid antibiotic medicine ensures the solid medicine particles are evenly mixed for an accurate dose.
Sweating cools your body because liquid sweat absorbs heat from your skin to evaporate into a gas.
Filtering dirty floodwater through a clean cloth removes large solid dirt particles before you boil the water.
Stainless steel straws are safer for hot drinks than plastic straws because stainless steel does not melt.
Storing unused batteries in a cool, dry place prevents internal chemical reactions from leaking corrosive battery acid.
Wearing a white shirt on a sunny day keeps you cooler than a black shirt because white reflects sunlight.
Leaving cooked rice at room temperature allows bacteria to multiply rapidly, so uneaten rice must be refrigerated immediately.
